judgment.rationale: The author confirmed the stuck synthetic Right Shift behavior on prerelease 0.101.2373. The configuration is specific enough for a controlled current-build reproduction, but not enough to attribute the failure to one remap branch.
evidence: The report maps Right Shift to CapsLock and maps CapsLock+H to Backspace.
The author says Shift remains active until physical Right Shift is pressed.
KeyboardManager::HandleKeyboardHookEvent dispatches Alone, single-key, and shortcut remaps in sequence; HandleSingleKeyRemapEvent emits target key-up for the source key-up.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the exact mapping on a current build and trace physical and injected key-down/key-up events before selecting a code-fix layer.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code fix is not yet supportable because the exact event sequence and interaction between the two configured remaps have not been reproduced.

issue_context.summary: A CapsLock-based Keyboard Manager configuration appears to leave an injected Right Shift logically pressed after a shortcut is released.
known_information: The reporter supplied the intended mappings and a clear release-state symptom.
The behavior persists on the reported prerelease.
The issue has no assignee and carries a team-response label.
inferences: An unmatched injected modifier key-up or remap-dispatch interaction may be involved, but this is not confirmed.
issue_context.analysis: The version question is resolved, so a maintainer can reproduce directly. The source has explicit key-up handling, making an event trace more useful than requesting a generic diagnostic archive.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and both comments.
Inspected KeyboardManager hook dispatch and single-key injection handling in src/modules/keyboardmanager/KeyboardManagerEngineLibrary/KeyboardManager.cpp and KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp.
Checked related public tracker searches; no directly matching active duplicate was identified.

reproduce.version_requirements: Current main or a newer prerelease than 0.101.2373
prerequisites: Configure the exact single-key and shortcut mappings from the report.
steps: Type ordinary characters and observe modifier state.
Press physical Right Shift to verify whether it clears the state.
Capture physical and injected key-down/key-up events through the remap handlers.
reproduce.expected_result: Releasing the shortcut releases every injected modifier without requiring a physical Right Shift press.
setup_requirements: Record the exact Keyboard Manager mapping export used for the reproduction.
